tasks.design: Configure the existing catalogue requisition form in {PROCUREMENT} to reuse exact item descriptions, units and delivery headers after actual stock needs are captured. The teacher reviews the final request before its separate internal handoff; the assistant still checks real deliveries, stocks materials and records actual receipt facts after the event.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated catalogue and destination entry sits between actual stock checking and requisition review.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue forms can reuse stable fields while quantities and suitability remain human choices.
tasks.still_hard: Special-access materials may have specifications that a near-match catalogue item does not meet.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise an item that is technically similar but unsuitable for the actual teaching need.
tasks.altitude: Less repetitive requisition typing; no added purchasing authority or reduction of physical stocking.

evidence.claim: Native catalogue forms can remove repeated description/unit/header entry while physical stock, actual quantity and suitability checks remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is the assistant's requisition and actual stocking, including the existing receipt record. School purchasing staff separately place any supplier order in their unchanged normal workflow; this design neither performs nor claims saving on that external order. Teacher final suitability/budget review10 is actual other-role work, fully retained and excluded from focal denominator.

Assistant physical count in s1 and actual entry in s2 produce item ids/specifications, needed quantities and location. Catalogue owner supplies current item description, unit and price through ordinary catalogue maintenance; no newly cleaned feed is assumed. S3 retains actual item selection, field checks, missing-data capture and failed-prefill repair.

Test native catalogue entry first. The35% cut on s3 removes7 provisional hours of repeated existing catalogue fields and destination headers;13 remain for actual request content and correction. Existing prefill earns no saving. S4 binds the complete final requisition and queue; changes invalidate a1 before s5.
S6-s8 occur only after actual delivery. No predicted receipt or automatically completed stock count exists. Ordinary saves are retained within s2/s8 without an added self-approval stage or saving.
research_questions: Can native catalogue reuse preserve special-access specifications and require actual requested quantity?

tasks.short: Attend staff meetings and serve on committees

steps.what: Find and read actual current meeting papers and committee agenda in {DOCS}.
Attend staff meetings, listening, asking questions and contributing actual classroom-support experience.
Serve on required committees, considering proposals and contributing within the assistant's actual remit.
outputs: Human committee contribution and agreed responsibilities

tasks.design: Link the current agenda and papers from the existing {CALENDAR} invitation to {DOCS}. This removes only repeated file navigation; staff participation and committee judgement remain human, without creating a new minutes or action-register duty for the assistant.
tasks.previous_blocker: Meeting papers may be searched for despite an existing invitation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native invitation links can expose the current source rather than another copied attachment.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding the implications for actual classroom support requires participation and questions.
tasks.human_edge: Bring practical knowledge of what students and staff actually need.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less paper lookup; committee and staff responsibilities stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Native links to current meeting papers can remove navigation but not meeting participation or committee judgement.

assumptions: Boundary is attendance and committee service with actual existing paper reading. The assistant is not assumed to be secretary: no invented minutes, routine report, post-meeting register or written position statement is added. If an actual assigned committee deliverable exists, it requires its own scoped document work and receives no hidden benefit here.

Meeting organiser produces the invitation, current agenda and document links through normal meeting preparation, unchanged with no claimed source-authoring saving. S1 counts all substantive reading, wrong-version checks and manual fallback to locate missing papers. Native links remove only actual navigation.

Test existing invitation links first. The5% cut on s1 removes1 provisional hour of repeated file lookup, leaving19 reading/checking hours. All80 participation hours remain. No send, new author approval or ordinary save is introduced.
unknowns: Whether actual invitations already link current papers
research_questions: Do native invitation links remove a real search without pointing to an obsolete copy?
